title: Position of Parts of Speech (Ques. No. 151-200)
subtopic: Position of Parts of Speech (236 Marks)

questions.question: <u>After</u> the storm comes the calm.[]
questions.explanation:
after the storm → noun এর আগে
✅ Preposition
Trick: preposition + noun

questions.question: He went <u>down</u> the road.[]
questions.explanation:
down the road
✅ Preposition
Trick: direction + noun → preposition

questions.question: Mr. Kabir is <u>on</u> the committee.[]
questions.explanation:
on the committee
✅ Preposition
Trick: on / in / at → preposition

questions.question: Anwar jumped over the wall. Here 'over' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
over the wall
✅ Preposition
Trick: over + noun

questions.question: None <u>but</u> the brave deserves the fair. In this sentence 'but' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
none but the brave
✅ Preposition
Trick: none but = except

questions.question: The moral law is <u>above</u> the civil law.[]
questions.explanation:
above the civil law → law (noun) এর আগে।
➡ Preposition

questions.question: Don't talk <u>like</u> that.[]
questions.explanation:
like that → that (pronoun) এর আগে like।
➡ Preposition

questions.question: He stood <u>before</u> me.[]
questions.explanation:
before me → me (pronoun) এর আগে।
➡ Preposition

questions.question: He was only a yard <u>off</u> me.[]
questions.explanation:
off me → me(pronoun) এর আগে off।
➡ Preposition

questions.question: He came <u>after</u> my departure.[]
questions.explanation:
Preposition+Possessive adj+noun
after my departure → departure (noun) ,my(adj)
➡ Preposition

questions.question: <u>Despite</u> his illness he went to the college.[]
questions.explanation:
despite his illness → illness (noun) এর আগে।
➡ Preposition

questions.question: The plane flew <u>over</u> our head.[]
questions.explanation:
over our head → head (noun) এর আগে।
➡ Preposition

questions.question: We could not win <u>but</u> learned a lot.[]
questions.explanation:
win but learned → দুইটা clause যুক্ত করেছে।
➡ Conjunction

questions.question: I will watch <u>while</u> you sleep.[]
questions.explanation:
while you sleep → clause শুরু করেছে।
➡ Conjunction

questions.question: <u>Unless</u> you work hard, you will not succeed.[]
questions.explanation:
Unless you work → clause introduce করছে।
➡ Conjunction

questions.question: Five years have passed <u>since</u> I met you last.[]
questions.explanation:
since I met you → clause যুক্ত করেছে।
➡ Conjunction

questions.question: He is poor <u>but</u> honest. In this sentence which is conjunction ?[]
questions.explanation:
poor but honest → দুই adjective যুক্ত করেছে।
➡ Conjunction

questions.question: He sat behind me, <u>but</u> in front of you. Here 'but' is used as ---[]
questions.explanation:
behind me, but in front → দুই phrase যুক্ত করেছে।
➡ Conjunction

questions.question: The book was <u>neither</u> well-written nor interesting.[]
questions.explanation:
neither…nor → conjunction pair।
➡ Conjunction

questions.question: <u>What!</u> Can this be true ?[]
questions.explanation:
What! → বিস্ময় প্রকাশ।
➡ Interjection

questions.question: <u>Well,</u> I don't think I will be able to finish today.[]
questions.explanation:
Well, → আবেগ প্রকাশ।
➡ Interjection

questions.question: I found him guilty. Here 'guilty' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
found him guilty → guilty object কে describe করছে।
➡ Complement

questions.question: Which underlined word is a noun ?[]
options: That is the <u>last</u> of the butter.
questions.explanation:
the last of the butter → last এখানে বস্তু বোঝাচ্ছে।
Verbal noun(article+noun+preposition)
➡ Noun

questions.question: Which underlined word is an adverb ?[]
questions.explanation:
suits me fine → verb suits কে modify করছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: Which underlined word is adjective ?[]
questions.explanation:
happy home life → home life কে describe করছে।
➡ Adjective

questions.question: Man has been used as a verb in ---[]
options: The captain has to <u>man</u> the ship carefully.
questions.explanation:
man the ship → কাজ বোঝাচ্ছে।
➡ Verb

questions.question: The word 'oil' has been used as a verb in ---[]
options: There is no oil in the lamp.
questions.explanation:
oil your machine → কাজ বোঝাচ্ছে।
➡ Verb

questions.question: He became rich <u>overnight</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
rich overnight → কখন হয়েছে বোঝাচ্ছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: Medha wants to go shopping <u>tomorrow</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
shopping tomorrow → time বোঝাচ্ছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: She looks <u>very</u> beautiful.[]
questions.explanation:
very beautiful → beautiful কে modify করছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: The <u>warning</u> of the authority falls on deaf ears.[]
questions.explanation:
Verbal noun (article+noun+preposition)
➡ Noun

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.[]
options: He looked angry but did not speak angrily.
He looked angrily but did not speak angrily.
He looked angry but did not speak angry.
He looked angrily but did not speak angrily.
questions.explanation:
looked angry → look (linking verb) এর পরে adjective লাগে।
➡ Adjective

questions.question: The candidate did ----- and felt -----.[]
questions.explanation:
did badly → verb modify → Adverb
felt bad → feel (linking verb) → Adjective

questions.question: Jerry was deprived of <u>motherly</u> affection.[]
questions.explanation:
motherly affection → affection কে describe করছে।
➡ Adjective

questions.question: Upoma came here <u>late</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
came late → verb modify করছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: The children who play near the garden <u>water</u> the saplings.[]
questions.explanation:
water the saplings → কাজ বোঝাচ্ছে।
➡ Verb

questions.question: Shamim looked <u>around</u> but could not spot the man. The word 'around' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
looked around → looked কে modify করছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: To and fro' is an idiom. Here 'to' is used as a/an ---[]
questions.explanation:
to and fro → movement বোঝাচ্ছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: He came to office late'. Here 'late' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
came late → verb modify।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: The guests arrived <u>after</u> we had left for the market.[]
questions.explanation:
after we had left → clause যুক্ত করেছে।
➡ Conjunction

questions.question: She sings well enough. Here 'enough' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
well enough → well কে modify করছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: They organized a volunteer corps. Here 'corps' is a ---[]
questions.explanation:
volunteer corps → corps = group।
➡ Noun

questions.question:
People from all <u>walks</u> of life all ended the meeting.
<u>Copying</u> is prohibited in the examination.[]
questions.explanation:
Copying is prohibited → copying subject।
➡ Noun (Gerund)

questions.question: The flower smells -----.[]
questions.explanation:
smells sweet → smell (linking verb) → adjective লাগে।
➡ Adjective

questions.question: Cycling is <u>certainly</u> higher than driving.[]
questions.explanation:
certainly higher → adjective modify করছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: An <u>elected</u> member can take the decision.[]
questions.explanation:
elected member → member কে describe করছে।
Adj+noun
➡ Adjective

questions.question: There has been a <u>breakthrough</u> in the treatment of dengue.[]
questions.explanation:
a breakthrough → article a এর পরে noun।
➡ Noun

questions.question: We live upstairs. Here 'upstairs' is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation:
live upstairs → place বোঝাচ্ছে।
➡ Adverb

questions.question: Their house is <u>opposite</u> the Red Crescent Hospital.[]
questions.explanation:
opposite the hospital → hospital এর আগে।
➡ Preposition

questions.question: I <u>hardly</u> understand him. The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation:
hardly understand → verb modify করছে।
➡ Adverb
